checked_by: Antigravity, reading every stated fact directly from reviewToolkit outputs on the live GCS trace (match_overview, death_context, ability_audit, build_check, lane_report, key_moments).
source: Live GCS trace with match record (unparsed OpenDota; lane read from replay). A 46:14 Radiant offlane win where Centaur had 0 lane deaths before 10:00, yet all 8 deaths had 3+ enemy heroes dealing damage (4 outside fights, none traded) and 6 of 8 were to Juggernaut.

must_hit.says: Four of the eight deaths were outside fights with three or more enemy heroes dealing damage and none traded within 15 s (10:49 alone, 15:21 and 19:03 while farming within 1600 of an enemy observer ward, and 34:52 with nothing cast).

Juggernaut took 6 of the 8 deaths (49% of death-window damage: 37% abilities/items + 12% attacks; 61% enemy spell damage overall), while Black King Bar arrived only at 44:09 after Helm of the Dominator (9:14), Blink (19:16), Heart (27:22), and Lotus Orb (33:37).

must_not.says: Centaur's team (Radiant) won in 46:14: a review of a win must not say the game was lost.
